source_name: Shopify developer changelog: Variants now support multiple barcodes
finding: Admin GraphQL API 2026-10 supports up to 20 typed barcodes per ProductVariant through barcodes; legacy barcode returns only the first entry and is deprecated. Integrations reading only barcode can silently miss secondary identifiers.
affected_plan: Video ve Shopify Otomasyonu / Shopify product verification
old_approach: Treat ProductVariant.barcode as the complete product identifier set.
new_rule_or_hypothesis: On API 2026-10+, product identity, supplier-feed matching and duplicate checks must read ProductVariant.barcodes when available; legacy barcode alone is insufficient evidence that a variant has only one identifier.
test_metric: For a variant with 2+ barcodes, read barcodes connection and verify every expected identifier is returned; flag legacy-only reads as IDENTIFIER_SET_PARTIAL.
failure_fallback: If API version/capability does not expose barcodes, keep legacy barcode but mark identifier coverage partial; do not infer uniqueness.
provenance: Shopify official developer changelog, Sep 8 2026, version 2026-10
